w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Big-Eyes, The Big Beast, The Herald, Loud-Eyes, The Redactor) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Herald, Big Big, Gavel, The Big Beast) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Spool is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Terms of Service is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: You catch Sanne telling the fire about Leo. "Leo came back mauled by The Callback (3 rounds, 30 taken) and alive. Three white lines across the forearm now." The story's already growing.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ AD BREAK! You're on your own.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
firstContext: The Influencer is still frozen from your scream.
📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
You lock eyes and don't look away. It falters — then backs off, disengaging. Smart. (Stare Down — it backed down.)
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ TRIAL COMPLETE — the audience applauds, which sounds like static. (+15 integration, gift: a lesson: Grave Robber)
A weathered trader waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +2200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (20/15/9), with 7 wave-4 fought, 13 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 74 → 24 · capped · Craft 17 · Talk 19 · Explore 62 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Leo Martin ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,394 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.

✨ CAPSTONE: Seed Vault. Every seed you have ever pocketed, kept dry and dreaming. It weighs almost nothing. Almost. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
